CDIAL 13479 suptá asleep explicitly supplies both past forms (Lahnda suttā, Old Marwari sūto, Old Gujarati sūtaü) and new verbs Jaunsari sūtṇõ, Nepali sutnu, Bihari/Maithili sūtab, Bhojpuri sūtal and Hindi sūtnā. Thus the selected sut- responses can continue the old participle even when elicited as a verb. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
